title: Underwriting Guidelines, Owner Auto Policy: Package Acceptability Limits
content:
These are the acceptability limits of each Owner Auto Policy liability package. They apply when the package is bound or selected mid-term, and when a renewal term is offered in it.

| Package | Max violation points, new business or mid-term selection | Max violation points at renewal | Max at-fault accidents, 36 months | DUI/DWI within 60 months acceptable | Minimum years the named insured has been licensed | Foreign-only license acceptable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | 24 | 30 | 3 | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability | 16 | 20 | 2 | Yes | 0 | Yes |
| Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability | 12 | 16 | 2 | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability | 12 | 16 | 2 | Yes | 1 | Yes |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability | 6 | 8 | 1 | No | 3 | No |
| Cardinal Point 250/500/100 Liability | 4 | 6 | 0 | No | 3 | No |

**What each column measures.**
- **Violation points:** company violation points for the named insured and every rated driver, on a 36-month MVR lookback.
- **Accidents:** chargeable at-fault accidents in the 36 months before binding, counted across all rated drivers.
- **Years licensed:** the years the named insured has held a valid license in any US state or foreign country.
- **Foreign-only license:** a rated driver licensed only by a foreign country, and not by a US state.

### Certificates the package may back

| Package | May back an SR-22 certificate | States where its limits can back an FR-44 certificate |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | Yes | none |
| Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability | Yes | none |
| Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability | Yes | Virginia |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability | Yes | Florida, Virginia |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability | Yes | Florida, Virginia |
| Cardinal Point 250/500/100 Liability | Yes | Florida, Virginia |

**Boundary reading (hypothetical).** A highest-rated driver with 12 points is within the new-business maximum of the Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability package, because the maximum is 12. A driver with 13 points is not.
